recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical negation hedge at nearly every paragraph's close
instances: The bones permit a sequence when their condition supplies one.
The record does not allow every individual from Lachish to be followed by name.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Steelman-then-limit chapter engine with the same verb ('fails at', 'reaches its limit at')
instances: The stabilizing claim fails at that point.
The claim reaches its limit at the alliances gathered around the Spanish return.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Object-anchor closer: every section ends on a short affectless sentence placing a named artifact
instances: At Jericho, the stone tower rises from the settlement's early ditch.
the bronze cannon lay in the wreck of the Girona off County Antrim.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Uniform paragraph geometry: five to eight declarative sentences, subject-first, no dialogue
instances: A campfire required fuel. Food had to be transported, cut, opened, cooked, and distributed.
Storage made that claim visible. Granary remains at Mehrgarh...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Counterfactual-evidence inventory as a section type
instances: Contemporary records from Median settlements could show whether local officials stopped sending tribute...
Corroboration would need to remain close to the event.

summary: Reasoning strongest; templating of a subtler kind: negation hedge, steelman-and-limit chassis, object-anchor closer, same paragraph shape; chapter 10 opens near-contentless and ends in caveats, so the book stops instead of concluding.
